_comment: Read by check_no_stub_scripts.py. Every *.sh under scripts/ (scripts/tests/ excluded) needs an entry. external: the real-mode path must invoke aws/curl/gitleaks/atx/git clone/install.sh/pwsh or a wrapper of them. pure: local-only, exempt. fail-closed: real mode must exit non-zero in a real-only branch.

scripts/aimf/lock-fsxadmin.sh.reason: puts and deletes the Secrets Manager resource policy denying the Linux role read access to appmod/fsxadmin with aws secretsmanager

scripts/aimf/run-atx.sh.reason: real mode exits 2 until the atx invocation is verified and recorded (U8-U11)

scripts/aimf/setup-workspace.sh.reason: clones the pinned upstream with git clone, runs its install.sh, and runs the gitleaks send-scan self-test

scripts/create-secrets.sh.reason: generates passwords and creates the Secrets Manager secrets with aws secretsmanager

scripts/deploy.sh.reason: creates and executes the CloudFormation change set with aws cloudformation

scripts/inventory.sh.reason: lists and hashes files under a local mount point; no AWS or ONTAP call

scripts/lib/entry-check.sh.reason: sourced helper that checks the estimate and approval JSON files locally

scripts/ontap/check-no-locking.sh.reason: reads every volume's locking fields over ONTAP REST with curl, the password via aws secretsmanager

scripts/ontap/integration-clone.sh.reason: creates and deletes snapshots and FlexClones over ONTAP REST through the lib-ontap-rest.sh wrappers

scripts/ontap/lib-ontap-rest.sh.reason: sourced ONTAP REST helpers; ontap_call runs curl and ontap_login runs aws secretsmanager

scripts/ontap/record-boundary.sh.reason: reads the boundary state over ONTAP REST with curl, the password via aws secretsmanager

scripts/ontap/stage0-smb.sh.reason: creates the SMB share, ACLs, directories and REST roles over ONTAP REST with curl

scripts/ontap/stage1-nfs.sh.reason: adds the export policy, UNIX users and name mappings over ONTAP REST through the lib-ontap-rest.sh wrappers

scripts/preflight.sh.reason: read-only describe and get calls with aws before deploy

scripts/probe-launch.sh.reason: reads the SMB credential with aws secretsmanager and bridges probe sync files with aws s3 cp

scripts/run-probe.sh.reason: starts the probes with aws ssm send-command and collects results with aws ssm get-command-invocation

scripts/teardown.sh.reason: deletes stacks, volumes, policies and secrets with aws and runs the ONTAP checks over SSM
